## Decisions

- Use a dark editorial hero with a clean portrait-led visual panel and restrained technical detailing; keep supporting labels minimal.
- Use a compact floating navigation shell with a clean custom monogram, icon-led destinations, and a prominent contact action; avoid status dots and repeated role labels in the brand.
- Use a subtle CSS-only accent glow on navbar hover and keyboard focus, with reduced-motion support.
